svg.title: Income · Other income wireframe
svg.text: Pension, Social Security, rental, and inheritance.
Rental is 50% rented: only the rental share enters cash flow and tax.
Computed by the backend, never in the browser
Taxable Social Security depends on other
income. The engine estimates it each year.
Each source stores timing, amount, owner, and tax treatment. The pension row starts exactly in its payout year.
Provisional income and taxable Social Security come from the backend. The UI shows the estimate and its inputs,
Amount and start fields switch by type: pension asks payout start; inheritance asks year only; rental asks rent and
Tax treatment is explicit per source so later tax slices do not reopen this form.
